name: FlutLink
subtitle: FlutCloud client for iOS
description: Official FlutLink source. FlutLink is a dedicated FlutCloud client — files, sharing and administration, built with Kotlin Multiplatform. Distributed as an unsigned IPA for sideloading via AltStore Classic (AltServer signs it with your Apple ID).

apps.name: FlutLink
apps.subtitle: Files, sharing and admin for your FlutCloud server.
apps.localizedDescription:
FlutLink is the mobile client for the FlutCloud server (Nextcloud + FlutCloud app). It connects exclusively to servers running the FlutCloud Nextcloud app.

- Files: WebDAV browsing, upload/download, share sheet, folder management, global search
- Admin: OCS user & group administration
- Security: tokens are stored securely, never logged

This build is distributed unsigned; AltStore Classic signs it on install.
